verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right (logo, headline, CTA) and keeps a pop-art panel. But the panel is a cramped, cropped scrap (half a pink circle, a navy wedge), and the FIZZBANG pill straddles its edge over the yellow stripe, so the overlap looks accidental. B removes almost all of the brand graphics, leaving stray pink and blue slivers at both edges; its logo pill is jammed against the left canvas edge and the CTA nearly touches the right edge, so it has no margins and looks like a cropped strip rather than a designed banner.
